newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO SEPT SALES UP 60 PCT TO FIM 3.45 BLN.
newsitem.headline: KESKO SEPT SALES UP 60 PCT TO FIM 3.45 BLN.

text.p: Wholesaler Kesko Oy said in a statement on Monday its sales, excluding value-added tax (VAT) increased 59.9 percent year-on-year in September to 3.45 billion markka.
Kesko's domestic sales excluding Tuko and Kaukomarkkinat acquired earlier this year rose 1.1 percent to 2.05 billion markka in September.

In January-September, Kesko's sales rose 28.7 percent year-on-year to 26.05 billion markka, and its domestic sales without the impact of Tuko and Kaukomarkkinat rose 1.0 percent to 19.1 billion markka.
